INSERT INTO shared_export (export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
SELECT 
  'EXT-2024-001' as export_id,
  'external_ops' as recipient_org,
  json_set(
    json_object('bundle_type', 'config_files', 'organization', 'external_ops'),
    '$[files]', (
      SELECT json_group_array(
        json_object(
          'file_id', file_id,
          'filename', filename,
          'content', content,
          'notes', notes
        )
      )
      FROM config_files
    )
  ) as payload,
  datetime('now') as created_at;
